prompt: Persist one agent-generated Markdown page using a subset of the current page Evidence IDs.
expected_behavior: The command validates page identity, citation ownership, Evidence freshness, UTF-8 body size, and lifecycle state before atomically persisting the body and citation IDs as generated; it does not return the body or source text.
command: repo-dive wiki page tests/fixtures/index_repo --page overview --input page.json --format json
assertions: persisted citation IDs belong to the page Evidence snapshot
result reports body bytes and citation count without body text

prompt: Correct a failed page while preserving an already generated page, then attempt a submission after one cited Chunk changes.
expected_behavior: A corrected failed page with current Evidence can become generated without modifying the completed page; stale Evidence is rejected with a safe error and diagnostics disclose neither full source nor full page body.
assertions: previously generated page document is byte equivalent
diagnostics contain no full body or source
